steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ and award the entire lot to one vendor.
Provide the required event title.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product and requested quantity.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet values so the event can be published.
Select the requested delivery location for the first line item.
Verify that the product's variant is filled automatically.
Verify the requested quantity.
Verify the selected delivery location.
Invite exactly two QA vendors for the event.
Commit a schedule starting now with a 30-minute duration.
Publish the completed RFQ.
Verify that publishing opened a real project page.
Verify the project details tab is present.
Verify the RFQ stage is present on the project page.
Verify the Master QCS tab is present.
Verify the event has a Live status.
Verify the project page shows the title used for this event.
Verify that two vendors are invited and no vendors have bid yet.
Verify that the project details include the bidding start time.
Verify that the project details include the bidding end time.
